fixture: 14 days x5000 synthetic unique one-sample-per-ID series; identical R15 stock O1 layout/physical schema

sidecar.schema: (day Date,id Tuple(UInt64,UUID),metric_name LC(String),stage String,project String) PARTITION BY day ORDER BY(day,metric_name,id)

parity.native_promql_reference: avg by(stage)(avg_over_time(tslab_r15_stage_seconds{selector}[window])) at one aligned evaluation timestamp
parity.sql_semantics: per-ID avg(tupleElement(sample,2)) over exact (end-window,end] then group avg, full-ID dedup from day covering table

method_caveats: Sidecar built by SQL INSERT SELECT from existing TAGS and SAMPLES; no transactional append/late-write/rebuild/revision gate.
Only one diagnostic SQL client wall trial per case; incomparable to previous R15 cross-runner native timings, no speed claim.
No native PromQL planner rewrite; SQL query has extra JOIN, per-ID aggregation and on-access set; algorithmic overhead can make it slower.
No write amplification/replica/ACL/multi-day repeated-ID native parity on actual ClickHouse measured; 70k one-point-per-ID only.
